<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Still no response from Brad. We're now at the end of the day on Friday. This is concerning, as the meeting needs to be scheduled for next week. I am completely dependent on him to move forward. I have done my part by providing the available slots for the partners I can see.

At this point, I have to assume he will see my message when he comes online next. There is no other way to communicate with him. I will end this session and hope that by my next session on Monday, he will have had a chance to check the calendars and respond. There is nothing else for me to do.
